territories.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Saint Vincent and the Grenadines levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 445, administered by the Inland Revenue Department: section 8 imposes it on the taxable supply and the taxable import, with a standard rate of 16 per cent and a reduced rate of 11 per cent for accommodation according to the Department, a zero rate for the supplies of the First, Second and Third Schedules and exemption for those of the Fourth.
